must_have_properties: Exactly 3 TMDS data differential pairs (TX0, TX1, TX2) + 1 TMDS clock differential pair (TXC).
TX0 carries Blue[7:0] (DE=high) and {VSYNC,HSYNC} (DE=low).
TX1 carries Green[7:0] (DE=high) and {CTL[1],0} (DE=low).
TX2 carries Red[7:0] (DE=high) and {CTL[3],CTL[2]} (DE=low); CTL[3] always 0 (HDCP reserved).
Per-channel 8b→10b transition-minimised encoding with running DC-balance.
10 bits per pixel clock per channel; LSB-first on the wire.
Single-ended TMDS swing 400-600 mV (R_TFADJ ≈ 510 Ω).
Differential swing = 2 × V_SWING = 800-1200 mV pp.
DC-coupled differential (no AC coupling).
Internal PLL multiplier = 10× IDCK; TMDS bit clock = 10 × pixel clock.
Pixel clock 25-165 MHz.
100 Ω differential impedance on PCB.
Receiver supplies HPD HIGH when connected and powered.
I2C target at 0b0111_A3A2A1 base address when ISEL=1.
DDC bridge to receiver EDID at 0xA0/0xA1.
After reset, CTL_1_MODE.PD = 0 (powered down); host must set PD=1 over I2C.
Intra-pair skew t_sk(D) ≤ 50 ps at 165 MHz.
Channel-to-channel skew t_sk(CC) ≤ 1.2 ns at 165 MHz.
Output clock jitter t_ojit ≤ 150 ps relative to IDCK.
TMDS rise/fall 75-240 ps (20-80%) at 165 MHz.
Four control-character codes per channel (high transition density) used during blanking.
must_not_have_properties: AC coupling on TMDS pairs (would break RSEN sense + receiver bias).
Pixel clock > 165 MHz (PLL out of lock range).
Differential clock in high-swing mode (not supported per spec; reduces common-mode noise rejection).
12-bit single-edge clock mode (not a supported configuration combination — see Table 6-1 footnote 2).
24-bit dual-edge clock mode (not supported — see Table 6-1 footnote 3).
Page-mode I2C access (only byte read/write supported).
Assumed automatic TMDS enable after reset (PD=0 default; explicit PD=1 required).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: f_IDCK outside 25-165 MHz, or excessive IDCK jitter (>2 ns). TMDS output undefined.
DATA arrives within t_su or t_h window violation; receiver decodes wrong byte.
R_TFADJ wrong value; V_SWING outside 400-600 mV; eye degraded.
t_sk(D) > 50 ps or t_sk(CC) > 1.2 ns at 165 MHz; receiver may misalign 10-bit symbols.
Receiver disconnected or unpowered; HTPLG=0; MDI fires; host should gate output.
No DC current draw on TX0; RSEN=0; source may conclude no receiver.
Wrong address strap, missing pull-ups, or bus contention; transaction aborted.
Receiver NAKs at 0xA0; source falls back to default DVI mode (640x480 @ 60 Hz).
Encoder bug or mid-stream reset causes per-channel disparity to diverge from receiver's state; visible as colour glitches.
Receiver fails to recognise high-density control code; loses sync.

fields.max_clock_constraint: f_IDCK ≤ 165 MHz (DVI 1.0 single-link limit; PLL upper bound).
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: ISEL/RST cycled LOW→HIGH asynchronously resets all I2C registers to default values. PD register defaults to 0 (powered down). Host MUST write PD=1 to enable normal operation. Pin-strap config (BSEL/DSEL/EDGE/V_REF + state pins PD/DKEN) is sampled when ISEL=0; in ISEL=1 mode the register values override.
